tests.name: Quick Check
tests.description: Timed check on Spelling Rules and Patterns

questions.question: Which is correct: "their book" or "there book"?
questions.correctAnswer: "their book" - their shows possession (belonging to them)
questions.explanation: Answer: "their book" - their shows possession (belonging to them)

questions.question: Spell the word meaning "to influence": affect or effect?
questions.correctAnswer: "affect" - affect is the verb meaning to influence
questions.explanation: Answer: "affect" - affect is the verb meaning to influence

questions.question: What is the correct spelling: neccessary or necessary?
questions.explanation: Answer: necessary - one c, two s

questions.question: Add the suffix -ing to the word "hop" - what do you get?
questions.correctAnswer: hopping - double the consonant after a short vowel
questions.explanation: Answer: hopping - double the consonant after a short vowel

questions.question: Complete this sentence: "You're going to lose / loose your keys."
questions.correctAnswer: lose - lose means to misplace; loose means not tight
questions.explanation: Answer: lose - lose means to misplace; loose means not tight
